segment_definitions.description: Treat the source as robot-mounted first-person video from a wrist, end-effector, arm, or onboard camera, independently from human-wearer and fixed-camera profiles. Cover the complete supplied timeline with consecutive, non-overlapping semantic episodes and no gaps. Start a new episode when the observable robot or end-effector action, end-effector-object relation, visible gripper configuration, central task object, procedure stage, object appearance or position, or camera-motion regime meaningfully changes. Every episode must be no longer than $maximum_segment_seconds seconds. Do not summarize a long interval using only its dominant activity. If the visible action is unchanged, emit another consecutive observation with the same semantics; the new boundary is continued observation, not an invented action change. Requested observation density: $requested_density observations per minute; this is the minimum review cadence, not permission to carry a dominant label over uninspected footage. Post-processing cannot recover a visible action change missed here. Report only visible evidence. Do not describe robot hardware as a human hand or wearer. Do not infer control commands, autonomy, intent, force, torque, depth, physical contact, a successful grasp, object retention during occlusion, task success, equipment state, safety, or compliance. A gripper surrounding or moving near an object is a visible 2D relation, not proof of contact or grasp. Name a robot component, end effector, tool, or task object only when distinctive visible geometry supports that identity; otherwise use a conservative generic visible noun.

fields.name: scene_caption
fields.description: A concise factual caption of the visible robot-view scene

fields.name: environment
fields.description: A short visible environment label such as workbench, robot workcell, cabinet area, packing area, or not observable

fields.name: robot_action
fields.description: A concise present-tense phrase naming the robot or end effector's observable motion or action, stationary when visibly unchanged, or not observable. Describe visible motion only and do not infer the command, controller state, intent, or outcome

fields.name: action_description
fields.description: One precise factual sentence describing the visible robot, end-effector, and task-object motion. Do not infer force, torque, depth, hidden contact, successful grasp, retention during occlusion, or successful completion

fields.name: spatial_context
fields.description: Visible 2D relationships among the end effector, gripper, robot components, and task objects; use not observable when framing, blur, or occlusion prevents assessment. Do not infer depth or contact

fields.name: evidence_quality
fields.description: Choose exactly one: clear, partial, occluded, or not observable, based on visibility of the robot action, end effector, and central task object under robot-camera motion

fields.name: localization_targets
fields.description: Up to 12 canonical singular labels for concrete, boxable robot components and foreground task objects visible in this episode. Prefer specific nouns such as robot gripper, robot wrist, cable, clip, bottle, keyboard, tool, or box. Exclude people, human body parts, actions, states, text, regions, backgrounds, and duplicate synonyms

fields.name: procedure_stage
fields.description: Choose exactly one matching label from $procedure_stages; use idle when no robot task action is visible or other when none matches. Map only direct visible evidence; this is not a task-success or completion decision

fields.name: visible_robot_components
fields.description: Specific singular robot-component nouns clearly visible in the episode, such as robot arm, robot wrist, robot gripper, suction cup, or end effector. Do not call robot hardware a hand, infer hidden components, or infer that a component is functioning

fields.name: task_objects
fields.description: Specific singular nouns for the central visible objects being approached, surrounded, moved near, repositioned, or inspected. Do not infer grasp, contact, or retention from proximity or shared motion alone

fields.name: end_effector_object_interaction
fields.description: A conservative visible 2D relation such as gripper approaching cable, jaws around bottle, or end effector above keyboard; use none or not observable. Do not infer contact, grasp, pressure, tool use, or object retention

fields.name: object_state_change
fields.description: A directly visible before-to-after appearance, position, or orientation change of a named task object, or none/not observable. Do not infer hidden state, attachment, insertion, actuation, or task success

fields.name: gripper_state
fields.description: Choose a concise visible configuration: open, partially open, closed, changing, not present, or not observable. This describes appearance only and does not establish contact, grasp, holding force, or payload retention

fields.name: camera_motion
fields.description: Choose a concise visible camera-motion label: stable, robot-mounted translation, robot-mounted rotation, combined robot motion, rapid or blurred motion, or not observable. Do not describe robot-camera motion as head or walking motion
